newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar share prices higher after dividends.
newsitem.headline: Qatar share prices higher after dividends.

text.p: Shares on Qatar's unofficial stock market began to claw back gains after post-dividend adjustments, brokers said on Thursday.
The Commercial Bank of Qatar's (CBQ) 18-share index inched up fractionally to 128.01 points during the week to Thursday after falling 1.48 points to 127.53 in the previous week.
"The half-a-point gain in the index indicated the renewed strength of the market", said Mazin al-Shakarchi, CBQ's assistant general manager of treasury and investments.
The market turnaround came when Qatar National Bank, which had lost 135 riyals last week after paying out its dividend, recovered with a five-riyal gain to 530.
QNB accounts for a third of total market capitalisation of $1.9 billion.
Doha Bank Ltd -- Qatar's second largest in total assets and operations -- gained five riyals and Al Khaleej Insurance 10 riyals.
Qatar Shipping shed half a riyal to 45 and trading in Qatar Flour and Qatar Real Estate shares were suspended ahead of their AGMs.
